patient_group_explanation: Worms that can infect people and may produce IgE.

allergens.definition: Ascaris is a large intestinal roundworm. People pick it up from soil, unwashed hands or raw vegetables that carry worm eggs from contaminated ground or water.
exposure_sources: Unwashed hands after play or gardening
allergens.interpretation_insight: This result shows IgE to Ascaris proteins. It may reflect past or present exposure, and it cannot tell which. A positive result does not confirm a current worm infection. Your doctor decides whether stool tests or treatment are needed.
allergens.card_summary: A large intestinal roundworm spread through soil, water, raw vegetables and unwashed hands.
allergens.caution: Do not take worm medicines on your own because of this result. Your doctor will decide if further checks are needed.

allergens.definition: Toxocara canis is a roundworm of dogs. People can swallow its eggs from soil, sandpits or unwashed hands, especially children, dog owners and gardeners in parks.
allergens.interpretation_insight: This result shows IgE to Toxocara proteins. It may reflect past or present exposure, and it cannot tell which. A positive result does not confirm a current infection. Your doctor decides whether further checks or treatment are needed.
allergens.card_summary: A dog roundworm whose eggs spread through soil, pets and unwashed hands.
allergens.caution: Do not take worm medicines on your own because of this result. Tell your doctor if you keep dogs or have had eye or liver symptoms.

allergens.definition: Anisakis is a small worm found in some sea fish. Eating raw, lightly cooked or pickled infected fish can cause stomach illness or allergy in some people.
allergens.interpretation_insight: This result shows IgE to Anisakis. It can occur after eating infected fish, and a positive result alone does not prove allergy or infection. Tell your doctor if fish meals cause hives, swelling or stomach pain.
allergens.card_summary: A worm found in some sea fish, linked to raw fish meals.
allergens.caution: Do not stop eating fish based on this result alone. Tell your doctor about reactions after fish, especially if they were serious.
